description:
This message allows you to perform the same activities as a user does in the QB New Account form, which can be accessed in QB by selecting Lists->Chart of Accounts->Accounts->New. If you want the account to be a subaccount to an existing account, similar to using the SubAccount checkbox and selection list drop down in the New Account form, you use the `parent_ref` aggregate. Notice that the `parent_ref` can take either the parent account’s `list_id` or `full_name`.

The `account_add` wrapper from qbXML is also accepted. Returns the v2 request to send, and the webhook payload QuickBooks' answer arrives in (this operation's response_json: its data shape and the status codes to handle).

Possible errors (error.code / error.type; the call result explains each): 1030 unsupported_request, 3000 invalid_object_id, 3040 invalid_amount, 3070 string_too_long, 3100 name_in_use, 3120 object_not_found, 3140 invalid_reference, 3150 missing_element, 3175 in_use, 3176 locked, 3180 cannot_save, 3210 invalid_value, 3220 not_authorized, 3231 request_not_processed, 3250 feature_not_enabled, 3260 insufficient_permission, 3261 personal_data_access_denied, 3262 payroll_subscription_required, 3263 read_only_access, 3264 merchant_services_subscription_required, 3270 missing_posting_account

account_number.description: Account numbers appear in the QuickBooks chart of accounts, Account fields, and reports and graphs.

account_type.description: The type of QuickBooks account. You can’t create or modify a non-posting account through the SDK, because QuickBooks creates these accounts behind the scenes.

bank_number.description: The bank account number or an identifying note about the account.

currency_ref.description: A currency record defines how QuickBooks stores and displays a currency. Built-in currency name/code values are fixed; formatting and active status can vary by settings and workflow.

full_name.description: The record's name, parents first: `Jones:Kitchen:Cabinets`. Not case-sensitive.

list_id.description: QuickBooks' ID for the record. Used over `full_name` when both are sent.

include_qbxml.description: Also return the qbXML this compiles to, for debugging. Not part of the v2 request.

is_active.description: If `is_active` is true, this object is currently enabled for use by QuickBooks. The default value is true.

name.description: Name is the case-insensitive short name of a list object (without ancestors). It must be unique within its hierarchy scope.

open_balance.description: The amount of money in, or the value of, this account as of `open_balance_date`. On a bank statement, the amount of money in the account at the beginning of the statement period.

open_balance_date.description: The date when an opening balance was entered for this account.

parent_ref.description: A reference to the list object that is one level above this one.

full_name.description: The record's name, parents first: `Jones:Kitchen:Cabinets`. Not case-sensitive.

list_id.description: QuickBooks' ID for the record. Used over `full_name` when both are sent.

request_id.description: Your own label for the request, sent to QuickBooks as its qbXML `requestID` and echoed in the raw answer (`response_xml`); optional, since the answer's webhook already carries the request's `id`.

sales_tax_code_ref.description: `sales_tax_code_ref` points to the sales-tax code used for an item or customer context. QuickBooks includes default TAX and NON codes, and a code can be deleted only when nothing references it.

full_name.description: The record's name, parents first: `Jones:Kitchen:Cabinets`. Not case-sensitive.

list_id.description: QuickBooks' ID for the record. Used over `full_name` when both are sent.

tax_line_id.description: An internal representation of the tax line associated with this account.

name: create_account

body.description: The JSON body: the arguments you passed.

headers.description: Send with the request. Resent unchanged when no 201 came back, it answers with the request already queued.

qbxml.description: The qbXML it compiles to. Only with include_qbxml.

webhook.description: JSON Schema of the payload POSTed to webhook_url once QuickBooks answers, with this operation's response_json (data shape and status codes).
